state_sequence.description: 10 consecutive 2-second network behavioral state windows (pure-benign history required)

onset_probability.description: Attack onset probability in next 20 seconds [0.0 — 1.0]

lead_time_seconds.description: Forecast horizon (20.0s when alert is raised, 0.0s otherwise)

detection_threshold.description: Calibrated decision threshold (0.04 from validation max-F1)

mitre_candidates.description: Evidence-based MITRE ATT&CK technique candidates (heuristic, NOT a trained classifier)

forecasted_state_delta.description: 54-D vector: forecasted state minus current state (Δ S_{t+K} = Ŝ_{t+K} - S_t)

forecasted_state.description: Forecasted state at K=10 (20s ahead) — Ŝ_{t+K}

test_performance.ood_status: All 7 test episodes are fully OOD

important_caveats: Input must be pure-benign history (no attack traffic in any of the 10 lookback windows)
Input must be normalized with the provided scaler.pkl before passing to the model
MITRE attribution is deterministic heuristic scoring — NOT a trained classifier
Do NOT interpret MITRE confidence values as classification probabilities
Do NOT call this causal inference — feature deltas are correlational, not causal
Multi-seed variance: event recall 71.43%–100.0% depending on training seed
The FPR-constrained operating points (threshold=0.99) collapse to zero recall — operational use requires the 0.04 threshold with temporal aggregation
